integrity: The general theorem is proved symbolically. Exhaustive enumeration over q=2 and q=4 is supplementary and is not used as evidence for the infinite family. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Dimension two only; finite fields of characteristic two only. The result gives the sharp group-order bound and ambient-algebra classification but not a full simultaneous-conjugacy classification of all pairs (x,H).
title: Sharp characteristic-two \(\mathrm{GL}_2\) bound for constant-characteristic-polynomial cosets
